tool_args.rationale: The task guidance identifies narrow s_grad collinearity and directs an open-branch probe for wide s_grad leverage before fitting. This is the least-cost relevant available probe and distinguishes the unresolved local branch while supporting a full-range rho fit.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the standard siphon model using only the five pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The narrow s_grad span makes vmax and rho collinear, leaving the base parameters poorly identifiable.
The pilot s_grad values are subcritical; the supplied threshold-avalanche guidance applies only above s_grad 2.36.
It is explicitly irrelevant to resolving the identified parameter ambiguity.
